policies.name: standard_published_master_runtime
policies.usingExpression:
("naijue_erp"."standard_business_ready"() OR (("role" = 'ADMIN'::"text") AND ("hall_id" IS NULL) AND ("employment_status" = '在职'::"text") AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM "naijue_erp"."user_account" "a"
  WHERE (("a"."staff_id" = "staff"."id") AND "a"."login_enabled" AND ("a"."version" = 1) AND ("a"."auth_version" = 1) AND ("a"."created_at" = "a"."updated_at"))))))

policies.name: standard_published_runtime
policies.usingExpression:
("naijue_erp"."standard_business_ready"() AND (("import_batch_id" IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM "naijue_erp"."import_batch" "b"
  WHERE (("b"."id" = "sales_header"."import_batch_id") AND ("b"."status" = 'IMPORTED'::"text"))))))
